chunks.description_en: Moving forward through a moss-covered stone corridor on de_ancient, the Butterfly Knife held at lower-right while the inspect animation begins near the end of this interval.
chunks.description_zh: 在 de_ancient 长满苔藓的石质走廊中向前移动，蝴蝶刀持于右下方，检视动画在本段末尾开始。

chunks.description_en: Continuing forward then transitioning to a forward-right strafe with leftward yaw turns, the Butterfly Knife inspect animation is in full swing with the blade flipping prominently at screen center-right.
chunks.description_zh: 继续向前后转为右前斜移并向左转视角，蝴蝶刀检视动画全面展开，刀身在画面中右侧明显翻转。
chunks.view_change: brief leftward yaw revealing a blue bombsite sign on the left wall
environment_focus: blue bombsite marker sign on left stone wall
foliage visible through corridor opening ahead

chunks.description_en: Moving forward through a dark arched stone tunnel, the Butterfly Knife inspect animation continues with the blade extended and rotating at screen right, a bright rectangular exit visible ahead.
chunks.description_zh: 在黑暗拱形石隧道中向前移动，蝴蝶刀检视动画持续，刀身在画面右侧伸展旋转，前方可见明亮矩形出口。
environment_focus: rough stone floor with moisture sheen

chunks.description_en: Emerging from the tunnel into an open outdoor area with large stone ruins and dense tropical foliage, the Butterfly Knife inspect animation continues with the blade visible at lower-right.
chunks.description_zh: 从隧道走出进入开阔室外区域，可见大型石质废墟与茂密热带植被，蝴蝶刀检视动画持续，刀身在右下方可见。
environment_focus: large weathered stone ruin blocks outdoors
bright overcast sky above open area

chunks.description_en: Continuing forward with a rightward yaw turn and upward pitch near the end, the Butterfly Knife inspect animation concludes, revealing moss-covered stone ruins and lush foliage at screen left and center.
chunks.description_zh: 继续向前移动，末段向右转视角并仰视，蝴蝶刀检视动画结束，画面左侧与中央可见长满苔藓的石质废墟和茂盛植被。
chunks.view_change: rightward yaw with upward pitch revealing moss-covered stone ruins and foliage at screen left
environment_focus: moss-covered stone ruin surfaces at screen left
lush tropical foliage overhead and center
open sky visible through tree canopy

subject_list.subject_attribute: Dark gloves visible on both hands; holding a Butterfly Knife with a black handle and red accents, gripped at the lower-right screen anchor in a standard carry position; T-side agent.

environment_detail.area_or_callout: a stone corridor transitioning through a dark arched tunnel into an open outdoor ruin area
environment_detail.opening_view: Wide FOV at standing eye height looking along a moss-covered stone corridor; dominant geometry is rough-cut sandstone block walls left and right converging toward a bright outdoor opening at center; foreground shows the stone floor with faint moisture sheen, midground is the corridor interior, background is a sunlit exterior with foliage.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: A narrow-to-medium stone corridor leads into a fully enclosed arched tunnel that compresses the sightline to a single bright rectangular exit; beyond the tunnel the route opens into a broad outdoor area with large stone ruin blocks and no visible choke, offering wide lateral sightlines across a rubble-strewn ground plane.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: Rough-cut sandstone and limestone block walls with heavy moss growth, green algae staining, and surface cracks; stone floor with damp reflective patches; arched tunnel ceiling of fitted stone; outdoor ruin surfaces show weathering, chipped edges, and lichen.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: A blue bombsite marker sign mounted on the left corridor wall visible briefly during the leftward yaw; scattered stone rubble on the outdoor ground; fallen timber or log debris near the ruin base; dense tropical foliage bushes and tree canopy overhead outdoors.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: Interior corridor lit by ambient daylight spilling from both ends with soft shadows; the arched tunnel section is significantly darker with only the bright exit providing illumination; the outdoor area is brightly lit under an overcast sky with diffuse natural light and no hard shadows; no smoke, fire, or flash effects present.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: Standard CS2 HUD visible: crosshair at screen center, health and armor indicators at lower left, ammo counter at lower right, radar at upper left, weapon icon showing Butterfly Knife.

segments.visual_description_long: The opening view is a moss-covered stone corridor on de_ancient at standing eye height, rough sandstone block walls converging left and right toward a bright outdoor opening at center, the stone floor showing faint moisture sheen in the foreground. A blue bombsite sign is briefly visible on the left wall during an early leftward yaw. The route narrows into a fully enclosed dark arched tunnel, its fitted-stone ceiling pressing close, with a single bright rectangular exit ahead providing the only illumination. <Camera1>The first-person viewpoint sweeps briefly left, then settles forward through the tunnel into an open outdoor ruin area.</Camera1> Beyond the tunnel exit, large weathered stone ruin blocks and dense tropical foliage fill the left and center of the frame under a bright overcast sky. <Camera2>Near the clip's end the viewpoint turns rightward and pitches upward, revealing additional moss-covered ruin surfaces and a lush tree canopy overhead.</Camera2>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> performs a full Butterfly Knife inspect animation, flipping and rotating the blade through its complete presentation sequence before returning to a standard carry hold.</Action1>.

subject_list.display_name: 由玩家操控的 CS2 特工
subject_list.subject_attribute: 双手戴深色手套可见；持有一把黑色握柄带红色装饰的蝴蝶刀，以标准持刀姿势锚定于画面右下方；T方特工。

environment_detail.area_or_callout: 石质走廊经由黑暗拱形隧道过渡至开阔室外废墟区域
environment_detail.opening_view: 站立视角宽视野，沿长满苔藓的石质走廊望去；左右两侧为粗凿砂岩砌块墙壁，向中央明亮室外出口汇聚；前景为带有轻微潮湿光泽的石质地面，中景为走廊内部，背景为阳光照射的室外植被区域。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 中等宽度石质走廊通向完全封闭的拱形隧道，视线收窄至单一明亮矩形出口；隧道外为宽阔室外区域，大型石质废墟砌块散布，无明显卡口，提供宽阔横向视野。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 粗凿砂岩与石灰岩砌块墙面，覆有大量苔藓、绿藻污渍及裂缝；石质地面带潮湿反光区域；拱形隧道天花板为拼合石块；室外废墟表面风化严重，边缘破损并附有地衣。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 左侧走廊墙壁上短暂可见蓝色炸弹点标识牌；室外地面散落石块碎片；废墟底部附近有倒木或原木残骸；室外上方有茂密热带植被灌木与树冠。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 走廊内部由两端透入的环境日光照明，阴影柔和；拱形隧道段明显较暗，仅前方出口提供照明；室外区域在阴天天空下明亮，漫射自然光，无硬阴影；无烟雾、火焰或闪光效果。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 标准 CS2 HUD 可见：准星位于画面中央，生命值与护甲显示于左下角，弹药计数于右下角，雷达于左上角，武器图标显示蝴蝶刀。

segments.visual_description_long: 开场视角为 de_ancient 长满苔藓的石质走廊，站立视角宽视野，左右粗凿砂岩砌块墙壁向中央明亮室外出口汇聚，前景石质地面带轻微潮湿光泽。早期向左转视角时，左侧墙壁上短暂可见蓝色炸弹点标识牌。路线收窄进入完全封闭的黑暗拱形隧道，拼合石块天花板低矮压迫，前方单一明亮矩形出口为唯一光源。<Camera1>第一人称视角短暂向左扫视后，向前穿越隧道进入开阔室外废墟区域。</Camera1>隧道出口外，大型风化石质废墟砌块与茂密热带植被在阴天明亮天空下充满画面左侧与中央。<Camera2>片段末尾视角向右转并仰视，露出更多长满苔藓的废墟表面与茂盛树冠。</Camera2>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|>执行完整的蝴蝶刀检视动画，刀身经历完整的翻转与旋转展示序列后回到标准持刀姿势。</Action1>。
